dogecoin.text: I told myself not to buy crypto until firmly into a lengthy bear market, but then @etoro listed #dogecoin so last night I opened a small position and I'm already 20% up.  I hear Elon is on SNL this week, so will hold

Sold at 47% profit. Could have got 60% last night but thought Musk-mania might push #dogecoin higher today... Spidey-senses are screaming that there's a big(ger) drop coming in next few hours (1 benefit of having been on the #xrp roundabout for so long, I recognize hype and FOMO)
Feels like this is ground-floor pricing for the 2024-25 crypto bull run, with basement prices 8-10 or so weeks in the wing mirror.  Bags are packed, LFG 🚀 $HBAR $AMP $DOGE
